_comment: The same three rounds, except every site also imports one in-repo module. The builtins are shared by all three files too, so a ranking that counts specifiers alone would pick `path`; the seam must be the module that owns the primitive.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the row after the await**

The row is read before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race and nothing revalidates the row in between.
